loops.verdict: Good app, but not top-tier yet
loops.verdict_explanation: The Redux module graph and core algorithm port (Wilson-score H2H, warm-start pairings) are genuinely deep and well-tested. However, the onboardingSlice committed localStorage I/O directly inside reducer bodies — a Redux invariant violation that pulled ownership out of the persistence seam established by createPersistenceMiddleware. F1 and F2 resolved in loop 1. F3 (Item multi-URL) remains open.

domain_modeling.proof: models.ts:17-28 — Item interface retains three independent URL fields alongside ItemMedia discriminated union. F3 open.

data_flow.proof: onboardingSlice back-channel resolved (F1). All other flows explicit; unidirectional dependency graph.

framework_idioms.proof: require() in ESM thunk resolved (F2). Reducer side effects resolved (F1). Scores reflect pre-fix baseline.

concurrency.proof: No actor isolation concerns. debounce with clearTimeout. No floating promises. Synchronous require() (now resolved) was not a concurrency hazard.

simplicity.proof: clearDeferredPairs unused import resolved (F2). require() ceremony resolved (F2). headToHead.ts ~1356 lines passes deletion test.

test_strategy.proof: 238 pre-loop tests, 34 suites. onboardingSlice persistence paths now tested (new test added). 239 post-loop.

credibility.proof: dynamic require() and reducer-body I/O (honesty leaks) resolved. F3 still open. Scores reflect pre-fix baseline.

loops.unresolved_reason: F3 (domain modeling) open; domain_modeling score 8.5; credibility score 8.0 — below 9.5 threshold
builder_notes: Reducer body I/O: any localStorage.*, fetch(), setTimeout() inside createSlice.reducers.* body is the smell. Move to middleware or thunks.
Dynamic require() smell: require() inside a .ts function body that already has import statements at the top — add to top-level import instead.
Discriminated union invariant only as strong as the type that enforces it — if Item itself allows impossible state, createItem is policy not type constraint.
loops.narrative: Place — not top-tier yet. The H2H algorithm, injectable-storage middleware, and memoized selector graph are genuinely strong structural choices. Post-loop-1: onboarding persistence violation (F1) and dynamic require() (F2) resolved. Domain modeling residual (F3) remains. Next critic pass expected to show UP on architecture, state management, framework practices, test strategy, credibility after F1+F2 resolution is scored fresh.

loop_result.what_changed: Moved onboarding persistence into createPersistenceMiddleware (F-001 resolved); replaced dynamic require() with static import + removed unused clearDeferredPairs import (F-002 incidentally resolved).

Removed loadInitialState(), STORAGE_KEY, and all localStorage.* calls from onboardingSlice reducer bodies. Extended createPersistenceMiddleware persistedState with onboarding. Added persistenceMiddleware.test for completeOnboarding via fakeStorage seam.

implementation_review.reason: All three checks passed; F-001 + F-002 no longer present in current source; 239/239 tests pass; no unintended regression.
